import RNA

target = "((((((.((((((....)))))).(((....))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).(((....))).(((....))).((((((....)))))).))))))"
n = len(target)

# find pair map
stack = []
pair = {}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pair[i]=j
        pair[j]=i

seq = ['']*n

# helper: fill hairpin stem of length L closing at (i, j) with loop between
def fill_stem(i0, j0, L):
    # positions i0..i0+L-1 pair with j0-L+1..j0 reversed
    # use GC clamp at outermost, alternate GC/AU inside, strong
    gc_pat = ['G','C','G','C','G','C']
    cg_pat = ['C','G','C','G','C','G']
    for k in range(L):
        i = i0+k
        j = j0-k
        b = gc_pat[k % len(gc_pat)]
        comp = {'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}[b]
        seq[i]=b
        seq[j]=comp

# identify all stems: consecutive '(' runs immediately followed eventually by matching ')ss
i=0
while i<n:
    if target[i]=='(':
        j=i
        while j<n and target[j]=='(':
            j+=1
        L = j-i
        i0=i
        j0 = pair[i0]  # this is rightmost of the matching run... need j0 = pair of i (leftmost open) -> gives rightmost close of stem
        # actually pair[i0] gives the partner of first '(' which is the LAST ')' of matching run (outermost)
        fill_stem(i0, j0, L)
        i=j
    elif target[i]==')':
        # already filled via matching '(' pass, skip forward
        j=i
        while j<n and target[j]==')':
            j+=1
        i=j
    else:
        i+=1

# fill loops (4nt) with UUCG cap - place U,U,C,G in the dots between stem
i=0
while i<n:
    if target[i]=='.':
        j=i
        while j<n and target[j]=='.':
            j+=1
        L=j-i
        if L==4:
            seq[i]='U'; seq[i+1]='U'; seq[i+2]='C'; seq[i+3]='G'
        else:
            for k in range(L):
                seq[i+k]='A'
        i=j
    else:
        i+=1

seq = ''.join(seq)
print(seq)
print(len(seq))
assert '' not in seq
fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
mfe, en = fc.mfe()
print(mfe)
print(target)
print(mfe==target)
EOF
